title: Templars, Lalibela and the Ark in Ethiopia

tellings.quote: I speculated that he tipped the Templars off that the Ark of the Covenant was in Ethiopia

plain: The Ark of the Covenant, the sacred chest the Bible says held the tablets of the law, may have ended up in Ethiopia, and someone linked to Lalibela, a place of ancient rock-cut churches in Ethiopia, may have told the Knights Templar so. The Templars were a medieval order of Christian knights based on the Temple Mount in Jerusalem. The writer Graham Hancock tells Michels this was his own speculation in his book The Sign and the Seal, a guess that would tie the knights' search for the Ark to Africa.
